1. Use the <b>arrow keys</b> to find <b>:
1. Use the arrow keys to find "Snapshots" in the boot menu
2. Press Enter to expand the list of available snapshots
3. Choose the snapshot taken before the update
4. Press Enter to boot into that snapshot
5. Test your system — if issues persist, try an earlier snapshot
6. When satisfied, return here and run Restore Snapshot to make it permanent
7. Reboot once more and use the normal "linux" boot entry

A theme is a snapshot of your current lo: A theme is a snapshot of your current look — wallpaper, colors, UI changes, and window decorations. Tap "Save current as theme" to capture what's on screen, then switch between saved themes any time with one tap. Use "Update" on the active theme to overwrite it with your latest tweaks. You can also export a theme to a file and import it again later or on another computer. The wallpaper is included.
